proposed_graph: First M740 joins M739 trigger to an integral lever pivot.
Second M740 joins the trigger output to the upper eye of M778.
M778 passes along the lever to sliding M780; its threaded connection is secured by thequarter-inch nut.
M742 guides the pawl and is fastened by two complete5/16x1-3/4in rivets through actual lever material.

M744 biases the rod/pawl toward the quadrant; M745 likely provides a spring seat on the rod. Fixed spring-seat ownership and exact upper-pin assignment remain hypotheses requiring source/geometry review.
